description: This file defines the 'Popup_Picker' class, responsible for rendering a popup interface for selecting 'Campaigns' within the SuiteCRM application. It handles generating search forms, processing user input to filter campaigns, and displaying a list view with selectable campaign entries.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class that generates a popup interface for selecting Campaigns, handling search filters, list view rendering, and user interaction within the popup context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Popup_Picker class; performs no initialization.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs and returns a SQL WHERE clause based on current request parameters to filter campaigns.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the campaign selection popup, including search form, list view, and control buttons.
